mainEntity.name: What are metallic foil stickers and when should I use them?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can do both. Many designs combine metallic areas (like borders or icons) with standard CMYK colors for text or illustrations. When preparing artwork, clearly indicate which parts should be metallic vs. non-metallic.

mainEntity.name: Can I print colors on top of the foil, or is it only metallic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Foil stickers are printed on durable vinyl with a protective coating. They resist everyday handling, light scratching, and normal indoor use. For heavy-duty or outdoor applications, ask for laminated or reinforced options.

mainEntity.name: Are metallic foil stickers durable and scratch-resistant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, they adhere well to many curved surfaces when applied slowly and firmly, especially on bottles, jars, or tubes. For very small diameters or extreme curves, test a sample first to ensure smooth application without wrinkles.

mainEntity.name: Do metallic foil stickers work on curved surfaces?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Because of their premium look, foil logo stickers are popular for tamper-evident seals, certificates, award badges, or limited-edition seals on boxes and bottles.

content.meaningfulText: Home/Industries we serve Industries we serve · 8 sectors Custom stickers for the brands people touch. Every industry asks something different of a sticker: a cosmetics jar needs a raised seal that survives a bathroom shelf; a coffee bag needs a label that reads at arm's length; a toy needs a foam sticker a child can press. Below is how we build for each, which puffy, flat or packaging product fits, and why. Cosmetics & skincareBeverage & coffeeToys & collectiblesApparel & streetwearStationery & publishingEvents & educationCBD & wellnessFood & grocery 01 Cosmetics & skincare Jars, tubes and gift boxes live on bathroom shelves and in humid bags. A raised PU embossed seal or epoxy logo reads as premium at a glance and survives steam, oils and daily handling. Clear vinyl bottle labels disappear into the packaging and let the product color show through. Recommended builds Quote for cosmetics →Read: the psychology of quiet surfaces 02 Beverage & coffee roasters Bottles sweat, cans chill and coffee bags get squeezed. Water-resistant vinyl bottle labels hold color in the fridge; kraft mylar bags with valves and zippers keep beans fresh; a puffy cap sticker turns a limited run into something customers keep. Recommended builds Quote for beverage →Read: the complete guide to custom mylar bags 03 Toys, games & collectibles Children press, peel and re-stick. Soft EVA foam stickers take the abuse; kiss-cut puffy sticker sheets hold up to 40 characters per sheet and become the part of the box kids keep. For trading-card and figure lines, 3D labels add collectible depth. Recommended builds Quote for toys →Read: when 3D stickers become collectibles 04 Apparel & streetwear The sticker in the bag is the second impression after the garment. PU embossed labels feel like leather patches; holographic drops signal limited editions; puffy logo stickers end up on laptops and water bottles, free advertising that lasts years. Recommended builds Quote for apparel →Read: why custom stickers feel like objects 05 Stationery, planners & publishing Planner and journal buyers are sticker collectors by definition. Puffy sticker sheets, foil accents and clear vinyl sheets ship inside the product or sell as add-ons with high margin and low MOQ. Recommended builds Quote for stationery →Read: why sticker books never disappeared 06 Events, schools & education Volume, speed and durability in small hands. Foam stickers and budget flat stickers cover reward charts, conference badges and swag bags at the lowest unit cost, with an 18–20 business day turnaround, plan backwards from your event date. Recommended builds Quote for events →Read: puffy stickers for seasonal campaigns 07 CBD & wellness brands Compliance and shelf presence in one build. CBD packaging boxes with child-resistant closures and state label panels, matched mylar pouches for gummies and flower, and raised dome decals for tincture bottles that need to feel pharmaceutical-grade. Recommended builds Quote for CBD →Read: why a mylar bag is recognizable with eyes closed 08 Food, snacks & grocery Freshness first, then shelf appeal. Heat-sealable kraft or mono-PE mylar bags with windows and zippers; oil-resistant vinyl labels for jars and deli packs; paper and washable paper bags for the counter. One artwork, matched across every touchpoint. Recommended builds Quote for food →Read: why "paper is better" isn't the whole argument Industry FAQSector-specific questions.Don't see yours? Ask the team. Do you offer industry-specific compliance for CBD packaging?+Yes. CBD packaging boxes can include child-resistant closures, state-required label panels, batch and QR areas, and tamper-evident seals. Send your state requirements with the quote and we'll build them into the proof.Can food and beverage labels be water- and oil-resistant?+Yes. Vinyl bottle labels, epoxy stickers and dome decals are water-resistant; laminated vinyl handles oils and refrigeration. Kraft mylar bags are heat-sealable.Is there a different minimum for different industries?+No. Every product is custom-made from 250 pieces per design regardless of industry, with no die or plate charges. Your industry. Your artwork. From 250. Request a quote →

content.meaningfulText: Home/Payment terms Payment terms These terms cover standard orders placed on puffsticker.com: Custom Puffy Stickers and Custom Foam Stickers in the 1 x 2 in standard package, and the $45 Puffy Sticker Sample Pack. Custom work is quoted separately, and each quote states its own terms.How to payPay by bank transfer or Pay with Wise. We don't accept card payments. Unpaid orders are cancelled after 3 days.Your confirmation page and confirmation email both carry a Wise payment link for the exact total. We match your payment by the payer's name and amount. If you pay from an account in another name, reply to your order email and tell us.When payment is duePayment is due within 3 days of placing your order. We email a reminder 24 hours before the deadline. If payment has not arrived by then, the order is cancelled automatically and we email you to confirm. Nothing is printed before payment.A bank transfer can take a day or two to reach us. If you paid close to the deadline, reply to the reminder or cancellation email with your payment reference and we will hold or reinstate the order.What the price coversThe package total covers printing, a free digital proof before anything prints, and free shipping within the US. The sample pack price covers the pack and free shipping within the US. Where sales tax applies it is shown as a separate line at checkout; package prices on the site exclude it.After you payOnce your payment arrives we mark the order paid and send your free digital proof within 1 to 2 business days. Production starts when you approve the proof.Cancellations and refundsOrders cancelled after payment but before proof approval receive a full refund. Once the proof is approved and production starts, orders cannot be cancelled. A sample pack can be cancelled for a full refund any time before it ships. Refunds are paid back to the account the payment came from, and can take up to 7 business days to appear.Refunds are paid back through Wise. Reprints for production errors and transit damage are covered by our Reprint Policy.QuestionsEmail sales@puffsticker.com or call (407) 923-4382, Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00 Eastern. acceptedAnswer.text: Woven bags are made from tightly woven polypropylene (PP) that is then laminated with a glossy or matte film. This combination creates a strong, tear-resistant bag with a wipe-clean surface.

mainEntity.name: What are woven laminated bags made from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Woven laminated bags are designed for heavy loads like groceries, product samples, or catalogues. While exact weight capacity depends on size and handle construction, they’re significantly stronger than standard paper or thin plastic bags.

mainEntity.name: How much weight can woven bags typically carry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. They’re built for repeated use. The reinforced fabric and laminate protect both the bag and your printed branding from wear, making them ideal as reusable shopping bags or corporate gift bags.

mainEntity.name: Are woven bags reusable and long-lasting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. The laminated surface allows for vibrant, full-color printing of complex designs, photos, or gradients, turning the entire bag into a moving billboard for your brand.

mainEntity.name: Can I print full-color artwork on woven bags?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common uses include: Grocery and retail shopping bags Trade show and exhibition totes Corporate gifting and welcome packs Promotional giveaways where longevity matters

acceptedAnswer.text: 3D labels are raised, dimensional stickers (often puffy, domed, or foam-based) that add depth and tactile interest to your logo or message. They instantly make products feel more premium and noticeable than flat labels.

mainEntity.name: What are 3D labels and how do they enhance branding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flat stickers are a single layer of paper or vinyl, while 3D labels incorporate foam or resin layers to create thickness. This added dimension improves perceived value and makes your brand stand out on shelves or devices.

mainEntity.name: How are 3D labels different from regular flat stickers?

acceptedAnswer.text: 3D labels work well on: Product fronts and packaging Electronics and gadgets Branded equipment and tools Promotional items like cases or boxes Just ensure the surface is smooth and clean for best adhesion.

mainEntity.name: Where can I apply 3D labels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. With strong adhesive backings and protected print surfaces, custom 3D labels are built to withstand normal handling, bumps, and everyday use while maintaining shape and color.

mainEntity.name: Are 3D labels durable?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dome decals are widely used for: Equipment and machinery branding Electronics and control panels Automotive badges and emblems Premium logo badges on products or packaging

mainEntity.name: Where are dome decals commonly used?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The domed resin layer increases resistance to UV light, scratches, and general wear, keeping your logo clear and legible for extended periods—even in challenging environments.

mainEntity.name: Are dome decals UV- and scratch-resistant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom dome stickers are ideal for many outdoor or semi-outdoor applications, such as vehicles, tools, and outdoor equipment. Ensure surfaces are clean and non-porous for best adherence and longevity.

acceptedAnswer.text: Epoxy stickers are vinyl decals coated with a clear epoxy resin that cures into a raised, glass-like dome. This protective layer enhances shine, depth, and durability, making them ideal for premium branding and product labeling.

mainEntity.name: What are epoxy stickers and how are they made?

acceptedAnswer.text: It comes down to the tactile “feel.” Epoxy stickers feature a hard, glass-like resin dome that is sleek and rigid. Puffy stickers use a foam-based material that is squishy and compressible. The choice depends on whether your brand requires a high-end, smooth finish or a soft, 3D texture.

mainEntity.name: How do Epoxy Stickers (Smooth Depth) differ from Puffy Stickers (Soft Depth)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our 3D epoxy labels use a high-tack adhesive that bonds permanently to smooth, clean surfaces. They are ideal for metal, glass, plastic enclosures, and premium product packaging like custom Mylar pouches.

mainEntity.name: Which surfaces are best for 3D Epoxy Labels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The cured epoxy coating adds protection against moisture, minor scratches, and general handling, helping your branding stay clear and glossy over time.

mainEntity.name: Are epoxy stickers waterproof and scratch-resistant?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cured epoxy dome is hard and glossy, and it protects the print underneath from moisture, minor scratches and everyday handling. This keeps your branding looking pristine even on high-use items like laptops, mobile accessories, or industrial tools.

mainEntity.name: Will the 3D Resin coating scratch or dent over time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. We specialize in custom shape epoxy stickers. We can precisely pour the resin to follow the specific contour of your logo or branding, whether it’s a simple geometric shape or a complex, specialized die-cut design.

mainEntity.name: Can I get epoxy stickers in custom shapes and sizes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We use high-grade clear epoxy resin that is naturally waterproof and UV-resistant. Unlike cheaper alternatives, our epoxy stickers are designed to stay crystal clear without yellowing or cracking, even when exposed to direct sunlight and outdoor elements.

acceptedAnswer.text: PU embossed stickers feature a matte, leather-like finish with a fine grain texture, giving them a premium and refined appearance.

mainEntity.name: Do PU stickers have a matte or glossy finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The difference comes down to material, structure, and surface effect: PU Embossed Stickers Built using a multi-layer construction, PU stickers have a matte, leather-like textured surface with a soft-touch feel. Selected areas can be raised in a convex, protruding form, creating a controlled, material-based depth rather than a glossy or exaggerated 3D effect. Puffy Stickers Made using foam layers, they create a soft, thick, cushion-like 3D feel with more noticeable height and playful dimension. 3D Epoxy Stickers Coated with a clear resin layer, they have a smooth, glossy dome finish that creates a high-shine, glass-like appearance with strong light reflection. Each option offers a different tactile and visual experience, depending on whether the goal is subtle material depth, soft elevation, or high-gloss impact.

acceptedAnswer.text: Flat stickers are a single layer of paper or vinyl, while 3D labels incorporate foam or resin layers to create thickness. This added dimension improves perceived value and makes your brand stand out on shelves or devices.

acceptedAnswer.text: A dome decal is a printed vinyl sticker coated with clear epoxy resin, forming a smooth, raised dome over the design. This creates a glossy, premium badge that’s highly durable and visually striking.

mainEntity.name: What is a dome decal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dome decals are widely used for: Equipment and machinery branding Electronics and control panels Automotive badges and emblems Premium logo badges on products or packaging

mainEntity.name: Where are dome decals commonly used?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The domed resin layer increases resistance to UV light, scratches, and general wear, keeping your logo clear and legible for extended periods—even in challenging environments.

mainEntity.name: Are dome decals UV- and scratch-resistant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Epoxy stickers are vinyl decals coated with a clear epoxy resin that cures into a raised, glass-like dome. This protective layer enhances shine, depth, and durability, making them ideal for premium branding and product labeling.

mainEntity.name: What are epoxy stickers and how are they made?

acceptedAnswer.text: It comes down to the tactile “feel.” Epoxy stickers feature a hard, glass-like resin dome that is sleek and rigid. Puffy stickers use a foam-based material that is squishy and compressible. The choice depends on whether your brand requires a high-end, smooth finish or a soft, 3D texture.

mainEntity.name: How do Epoxy Stickers (Smooth Depth) differ from Puffy Stickers (Soft Depth)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our 3D epoxy labels use a high-tack adhesive that bonds permanently to smooth, clean surfaces. They are ideal for metal, glass, plastic enclosures, and premium product packaging like custom Mylar pouches.

mainEntity.name: Which surfaces are best for 3D Epoxy Labels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The cured epoxy coating adds protection against moisture, minor scratches, and general handling, helping your branding stay clear and glossy over time.

mainEntity.name: Are epoxy stickers waterproof and scratch-resistant?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cured epoxy dome is hard and glossy, and it protects the print underneath from moisture, minor scratches and everyday handling. This keeps your branding looking pristine even on high-use items like laptops, mobile accessories, or industrial tools.

mainEntity.name: Will the 3D Resin coating scratch or dent over time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. We specialize in custom shape epoxy stickers. We can precisely pour the resin to follow the specific contour of your logo or branding, whether it’s a simple geometric shape or a complex, specialized die-cut design.

mainEntity.name: Can I get epoxy stickers in custom shapes and sizes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We use high-grade clear epoxy resin that is naturally waterproof and UV-resistant. Unlike cheaper alternatives, our epoxy stickers are designed to stay crystal clear without yellowing or cracking, even when exposed to direct sunlight and outdoor elements.

acceptedAnswer.text: The difference comes down to material, structure, and surface effect: PU Embossed Stickers Built using a multi-layer construction, PU stickers have a matte, leather-like textured surface with a soft-touch feel. Selected areas can be raised in a convex, protruding form, creating a controlled, material-based depth rather than a glossy or exaggerated 3D effect. Each option offers a different tactile and visual experience, depending on whether the goal is subtle material depth, soft elevation, or high-gloss impact.

content.meaningfulText: Home/Refund and return policy Refund and return policy Our Refund & Return PromiseEvery PuffSticker order is custom-made to your specifications. Because each product is produced specifically for you, we do not accept returns. The $45 sample pack is stock rather than custom, and can be cancelled for a full refund any time before it ships. Refunds are paid back to the account the payment came from, and can take up to 7 business days to appear. However, if your order arrives with a production error or transit damage on our end, we will reprint it at no additional cost.We will reprint your order at no charge if any of the following apply:The finished product differs materially from your approved design or uploaded artworkThe print quality is defective, for example, smudging, missing colors, or misaligned printingYou received the wrong product, size, or quantityYour order arrived damaged in transitAll reprint requests require photo evidence of the issue received. You don’t need to send anything back; the photos are enough, and there is no return shipping to pay. Claims must be submitted within 7 days of delivery confirmation. We are unable to process requests made outside this window.The following situations fall outside the scope of our reprint policy, as they relate to customer-supplied artwork or decisions made prior to production:Files uploaded at low resolution or in an unsupported formatSpelling mistakes, design errors, or incorrect details present in customer-submitted artworkColor variation resulting from differences between screen displays and CMYK printing, minor variation is a normal characteristic of the printing processDelivery delays caused by an incorrect or incomplete shipping address given with your orderWe strongly recommend reviewing your artwork carefully before submitting. If you are unsure whether your files are print-ready, contact us before placing your order and we will advise.To submit a reprint request, please use our contact form and include the following:A clear description of the issuePhotographs showing the problem with the product(s) receivedSubmit a reprint request via our contact form. We aim to respond to all reprint requests within 1–2 business days.Once your reprint request has been reviewed and approved:The affected item(s) will be reprinted at no additional costProduction follows our standard turnaround timesReprints are shipped to your original delivery address using the same shipping method as the original orderWe will confirm approval and an estimated dispatch date by email.Orders cancelled after payment but before proof approval receive a full refund. Once the proof is approved and production starts, orders cannot be cancelled. Because all products are custom-made to order, we do not offer refunds as a standard resolution after that point. In the rare circumstance that we are unable to fulfil an approved reprint request, due to production limitations or other exceptional reasons, we will contact you directly to discuss an appropriate resolution, which may include a store credit or a full or partial refund. Refunds are paid back to the account the payment came from, and can take up to 7 business days to appear.If you have any questions about your order or this policy before submitting a claim, please contact our team. We are happy to help.
